exercises.title: A generic max that accepts List<LocalDate>, any Collection and inherited ordering
exercises.problemHtml:
Util.max was written the textbook way: static <T extends Comparable<T>> T max(List<T> xs). The given Main (do not change it) calls it with a List<LocalDate>, a List<Integer>, a TreeSet<String> and a List<LabGrade> where LabGrade extends Grade and only Grade implements Comparable<Grade>. Three of those calls do not compile — read the errors: LocalDate is Comparable<ChronoLocalDate>, not Comparable<LocalDate>, and LabGrade inherits Comparable<Grade>.

Rewrite the signature (and the body) so that every call compiles and returns the right type — the shape of Collections.max. An empty collection throws NoSuchElementException("empty collection"); Main prints its message.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 17+ — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change Main.java.
  • Do not call Collections.max — write the loop.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Util.max được viết theo kiểu sách giáo khoa: static <T extends Comparable<T>> T max(List<T> xs). Main cho sẵn (không sửa) gọi nó với List<LocalDate>, List<Integer>, TreeSet<String> và List<LabGrade> trong đó LabGrade extends Grade và chỉ Grade hiện thực Comparable<Grade>. Ba lời gọi không biên dịch được — đọc lỗi: LocalDate là Comparable<ChronoLocalDate>, không phải Comparable<LocalDate>, còn LabGrade kế thừa Comparable<Grade>.

Viết lại chữ ký (và thân) để mọi lời gọi biên dịch được và trả đúng kiểu — hình dạng của Collections.max. Collection rỗng ném NoSuchElementException("empty collection"); Main in thông điệp của nó.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: <T extends Comparable<? super T>> T max(Collection<? extends T> xs) is exactly the JDK’s Collections.max. The bound is a consumer of T (it takes T values to compare) ⇒ super; the collection is a producer of T ⇒ extends — PECS.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: <T extends Comparable<? super T>> T max(Collection<? extends T> xs) chính là Collections.max của JDK. Cận là nơi tiêu thụ T (nhận giá trị T để so) ⇒ super; collection là nơi sản xuất T ⇒ extends — PECS.

exercises.title: A PECS utility: move the passing marks into one List<Number>
exercises.problemHtml:
Marks.move(source, destination, condition) adds to destination every element of source that satisfies condition and returns how many it moved; Marks.average(xs) is the average of any collection of numbers (0 when empty). The given Main moves the passing lab marks (List<Integer>) and PE marks (List<Double>) into the same List<Number> with ONE Predicate<Number> "mark ≥ 5", averages three different lists, and moves the even lab marks into a Set<Object> with a Predicate<Integer>.

The starter signatures have no wildcards, so Main does not compile. Write the right wildcards (Producer Extends, Consumer Super) and the two bodies.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 17+ — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change Main.java.
  • Keep the method names and parameter order.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Marks.move(source, destination, condition) thêm vào destination mọi phần tử của source thoả condition và trả về số phần tử đã chuyển; Marks.average(xs) là trung bình của mọi collection số (rỗng thì 0). Main cho sẵn chuyển điểm lab đạt (List<Integer>) và điểm PE đạt (List<Double>) vào cùng một List<Number> bằng MỘT Predicate<Number> "điểm ≥ 5", lấy trung bình ba list khác kiểu, và chuyển điểm lab chẵn vào Set<Object> bằng Predicate<Integer>.

Chữ ký khởi đầu không có wildcard nên Main không biên dịch. Viết đúng wildcard (Producer Extends, Consumer Super) và hai thân hàm.

exercises.title: Sort a class list by four keys — and the TreeSet that drops students
exercises.problemHtml:
Each input line is a student code;name;major;gpa (major - = none). Build ONE Comparator<Student> that orders by: major A→Z with students without a major last, then GPA high→low, then name ignoring case, then code. Print the sorted list as %-6s %-12s %-5s %.1f (a missing major prints -), then how many students a TreeSet keeps when ordered by GPA only, and when ordered by your full comparator:

AI02   An           AI    9.0
...
TreeSet by GPA keeps 4 of 6
TreeSet by ORDER keeps 6 of 6

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 17+ — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Store students in record Student(String code, String name, String major, double gpa) with major == null when the input says "-".
  • One comparator chain in the constant ORDER.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Each thenComparing only breaks ties of the previous keys. The last key (the unique code) makes the comparator consistent with equals for this data, so the TreeSet keeps everyone; ordered by GPA alone it keeps one student per GPA value.

mistakesJson.loi: A .reversed() at the END of the chain reverses every key, not only the GPA.|||.reversed() ở CUỐI chuỗi đảo mọi khoá, không chỉ GPA.
Comparator.comparing(Student::major) alone — a null major throws NullPointerException inside sort.|||Chỉ Comparator.comparing(Student::major) — ngành null ném NullPointerException trong sort.
Believing a TreeSet keeps every element — it treats compare(a, b) == 0 as "the same element".|||Tưởng TreeSet giữ mọi phần tử — nó coi compare(a, b) == 0 là "cùng một phần tử".

exercises.title: A generic repository Repo<T, ID> — Spring Data’s shape in plain Java
concepts: generic class with two type parameters
Function<? super T, ? extends ID> as id extractor
exercises.problemHtml:
Write Repo<T, ID>, an in-memory store that works for any entity: the constructor receives a function that reads the id of an entity. Methods: save(T) (insert or replace by id, returns the entity), findById(ID) → Optional<T>, findAll() (insertion order), findAll(Predicate<? super T>), findAll(Comparator<? super T>), <R> List<R> map(Function<? super T, ? extends R>), deleteById(ID) → boolean, count(). findAll returns a new list — changing it must not change the store.

The given Main drives a Repo<Lab, Long> with commands (add id name seats, get id, find id, big n, sorted, names, delete id, count) and finally a Repo<Book, String> to prove the class is really generic.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 17+ — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change Main.java.
  • Keep the entities in a LinkedHashMap<ID, T> so that findAll() keeps insertion order (a replaced entity keeps its place).
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết Repo<T, ID>, kho trong bộ nhớ dùng được cho mọi thực thể: constructor nhận một hàm đọc id của thực thể. Các hàm: save(T) (thêm hoặc thay theo id, trả thực thể), findById(ID) → Optional<T>, findAll() (thứ tự thêm), findAll(Predicate<? super T>), findAll(Comparator<? super T>), <R> List<R> map(Function<? super T, ? extends R>), deleteById(ID) → boolean, count(). findAll trả list mới — sửa list đó không được làm đổi kho.

Main cho sẵn điều khiển một Repo<Lab, Long> bằng lệnh (add id name seats, get id, find id, big n, sorted, names, delete id, count) và cuối cùng một Repo<Book, String> để chứng minh lớp thật sự generic.

node cham.mjs

Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<thư-mục>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<thư-mục> — rồi node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<thư-mục> rồi node cham.mjs. Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 17 trở lên — javac -version phải chạy được.

Yêu cầu

  • Giữ thực thể trong LinkedHashMap<ID, T> để findAll() giữ thứ tự thêm (thực thể bị thay giữ chỗ cũ).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: This is the shape of Spring Data’s CrudRepository<T, ID>: an id extractor, Optional for "maybe absent", and every function parameter written with PECS wildcards so that a Predicate<Object> or a Comparator of a supertype is accepted too.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Đây là hình dạng CrudRepository<T, ID> của Spring Data: hàm lấy id, Optional cho "có thể không có", và mọi tham số hàm viết wildcard PECS để Predicate<Object> hay Comparator của kiểu cha cũng dùng được.

exercises.title: From anonymous classes to lambdas and method references — same output
exercises.problemHtml:
A LAB211-style subject manager sorts subjects by code with an anonymous Comparator, keeps the Java subjects with an anonymous Filter<Subject> (its own one-method interface) and sums the credits with an anonymous Runnable plus an int[] to dodge "effectively final". It works. Rewrite it with no anonymous class at all: Comparator.comparing, method references, lambdas, Predicate — the output must stay identical. Then finish the last step that is still a TODO: remove the subjects whose code starts with MAE and that are not 2-credit, using ONE combined predicate (and / negate) and removeIf.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 17+ — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • No anonymous class (new X() { … }) anywhere.
  • Same output lines as the anonymous version.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Một chương trình quản lý môn kiểu LAB211 sắp môn theo mã bằng Comparator ẩn danh, giữ các môn Java bằng Filter<Subject> ẩn danh (interface một hàm tự viết) và cộng tín chỉ bằng Runnable ẩn danh kèm int[] để né "effectively final". Nó chạy đúng. Viết lại không còn lớp ẩn danh nào: Comparator.comparing, method reference, lambda, Predicate — output giữ nguyên. Rồi làm nốt bước cuối còn TODO: xoá các môn có mã bắt đầu bằng MAE mà không phải 2 tín chỉ, bằng MỘT predicate ghép (and / negate) và removeIf.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A lambda is an instance of a functional interface written without the ceremony; a method reference is a lambda that only forwards to one method. Combining predicates with and/or/negate keeps each rule named and testable.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Lambda là một thể hiện của functional interface viết không cần nghi thức; method reference là lambda chỉ chuyển tiếp tới một hàm. Ghép predicate bằng and/or/negate giữ mỗi luật có tên và kiểm được riêng.

mistakesJson.loi: Keeping the int[] trick inside a lambda — it compiles, but it is the same hack in shorter clothes.|||Giữ mẹo int[] bên trong lambda — biên dịch được, nhưng vẫn là mẹo cũ mặc áo ngắn hơn.
isMae.and(twoCredits).negate() — negates the whole conjunction and removes every non-MAE subject too.|||isMae.and(twoCredits).negate() — phủ định cả phép "và", xoá luôn mọi môn không phải MAE.
